note: Hand review of al-Furūq terms that name more than one Qur'an Dictionary word (3 Oct 2026, MMSA Architect, each entry read in the Salīm edition's OpenITI text). values: term -> the Dictionary word(s) it means in this book, or null for none (the book's word is not one the Qur'an uses). byEntry: the same for one heading, which wins over values. Reasons are kept beside each choice.

reasons.الخطاء/الخطإ: The entry: al-khaṭaʾ is aiming at one thing and hitting another; al-khiṭāʾ is deliberate wrong (Qur'an khiṭʾ 17:31).
reasons.لكن: The entry's examples use the light lākin (ما جاءني زيد لكن عمرو).
reasons.القدرة: qudra (power) is not a Qur'anic noun; qadar/qadr are a different meaning.
reasons.البرء: al-barʾ (creating, as in al-Bāriʾ) is not birr/barr.
reasons.القطع: al-qaṭʿ (cutting) is not qiṭaʿ (pieces) or qiṭʿ (part of the night).
reasons.الال: al-āl here is the figure seen from afar, not the Qur'an's āl (family).
reasons.البشر: al-bishr (a cheerful face) is neither bashar (humans) nor bushr.
reasons.الزبر: al-zabr (writing on stone) is the verbal noun, not zubur (scriptures) or zubar (pieces).
reasons.الضر: The book's ḍarr/ḍurr (harm) is unvowelled; both Qur'anic nouns carry that meaning.
reasons.الأثم: The entry defines al-athīm (persisting in sin): the transcription drops the yāʾ.
reasons.المالك/مالك: mālik the owner, not Mālik the keeper of Hell (43:77).
reasons.بين: Only from the run-on heading الفرق بين قولك أنكر وبين قولك نقم: the word is the book's own 'between', not a compared term.
reasons.ذلك: «الفرق بين ذلك وبين …»: the book pointing back at the entry before, not the word ذَٰلِك.
reasons.اسمع/أمت: Transcription slips with no safe reading (السمع? أم?): left unlinked.
reasons.لوهن/لاسلام: Transcription slips for الوهن and السلام (the article lost its alif).
reasons.الجواب: The one entry (الجواب بالفاء والعطف) is about the grammatical answer clause, not a Qur'anic word.

byEntryReasons.الفرق بين العلم والخبر: Here al-khubr is knowing a thing through and through (Qur'an khubr 18:68).
byEntryReasons.الفرق بين العلم والحسن: The entry is about al-ḥiss (perception, أحسّ عيسى 3:52); the transcription writes الحسن.
byEntryReasons.الفرق بين المثل والمثل: The entry contrasts mithl (like) with mathal (description).
